# KAZE 風 (06 · kaze)

A Kyoto tea house — enso drawn on load, raked karesansui canvas, vertical typography.

- **Technique:** INK & CANVAS
- **Tags:** japanese, zen, minimal, calm, ink, traditional, light, craft
- **Best for:** restaurants; tea & coffee; spas; craft studios
- **Fonts:** Shippori Mincho, Zen Kaku Gothic New
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Shippori+Mincho:wght@400;500;600&family=Zen+Kaku+Gothic+New:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #f5f1e6 · #1c1b18 · #c73e1d
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/kaze/` (Template.astro, brush.ts, content.ts, meta.ts, petals.ts, sand.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `brush.ts`
  - `initBrushHeads(els: Iterable<Element>)` — Give each element a wobbly brush underline: an SVG path stretched to the element's width, with its length stored in `--len` so CSS can draw it with a dash-offset animation. Marks the element `.brush-head.rv` so the shared reveal observer triggers the stroke.
- `petals.ts`
  - `initPetals(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Faint vermilion petals drifting across the viewport. Removed entirely under reduced motion.
- `sand.ts`
  - `initSand(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Karesansui: gently drifting raked-sand lines that deflect around a handful of stones.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  brand: {
    /** Single kanji used as the logo mark, the large enso glyph and the menu hover stamp. */
    kanji: string;
    /** Romanised label next to the kanji in the nav. */
    navName: string;
    /** Romanised label next to the kanji in the footer. */
    footerName: string;
  };
  /** Top-bar links; each href targets a section id. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** `<em>` renders vermilion. */
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    cta: Link;
    /** Vertical columns shown right of the enso (desktop only). */
    vertical: {
      /** Small vermilion first column. */
      accent: string;
      /** Remaining columns; `<b>` renders darker. */
      columnsHtml: string[];
    };
    /** Bottom-right caption of the hero. */
    foot: string;
  };
  ceremony: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` gets the animated brush underline. */
    headingHtml: string;
    steps: {
      /** Duration badge, e.g. "§ 12 MIN". */
      duration: string;
      /** Outlined numeral glyph. */
      numeral: string;
      title: string;
      /** Japanese name with romaji, shown in vermilion. */
      jp: string;
      body: string;
    }[];
  };
  menu: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    heading: string;
    teas: {
      /** Japanese tea name in gold. */
      jp: string;
      name: string;
      description: string;
      price: string;
    }[];
    note: string;
  };
  garden: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` gets the animated brush underline. */
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Body paragraphs beside the raked-sand canvas; `<b>` renders darker. */
    paragraphsHtml: string[];
    haiku: {
      /** One verse line each. */
      lines: string[];
      /** Translation shown under the verse. */
      note: string;
    };
  };
  visit: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` gets the animated brush underline. */
    headingHtml: string;
    items: {
      label: string;
      /** Value line(s); `<br>` allowed. */
      valueHtml: string;
      note: string;
    }[];
  };
  footer: {
    note: string;
    /** Credit line above the showcase link (`<a>`/`<br>` allowed). */
    creditHtml?: string;
  };
}
```
